content.user_title: Plan Short-Video Visuals with Nano Banana
content.value_statement: Writing prompts one image at a time makes it harder to keep characters and visual style consistent across a video. Turn a brief or script into a prompt pack with shared visual details, framing, and checks for each asset.
actual_capabilities: Draft vertical cover prompts with a clear focal point and space for a title.
Turn a script into three to eight linked storyboard prompts, including first and last frames.
Define fixed character traits and reuse them in prompts for turnarounds, expressions, poses, and stickers.
Write prompts for matching props, scene backgrounds, and cutouts with a solid-background fallback.
Describe what to preserve in prompts for image cleanup, canvas expansion, or background replacement.
Provide a checklist for character identity, visual style, phone-size readability, and unwanted text.
limitations: Produces text prompts only. It does not generate or edit images, render video, or install an image model.
An image model can still change character details. A reference image may improve consistency but does not guarantee it.
True transparency depends on the image model. A solid background may require removal in a separate editor.
First and last frame prompts describe still images. Use a separate video tool for motion and timing.

use_cases.title: Plan a vertical cover
use_cases.description: Turn a video topic into a 9:16 cover prompt with a clear subject and space for a title.

use_cases.title: Storyboard an explainer
use_cases.description: Break a short script into linked keyframes with a consistent setting, palette, and lighting.

use_cases.title: Build a recurring character pack
use_cases.description: Specify fixed character details and reuse them in prompts for turnarounds, expressions, poses, and stickers.

prompt_templates.title: Write a cover prompt
prompt_templates.prompt: Write one 9:16 cover prompt for a video about growing basil indoors. Show a single bright plant and leave the top clear for a title.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Plan a thumbnail for a short tutorial.

prompt_templates.title: Break a script into frames
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn the script below into five vertical keyframe prompts. Keep the setting and palette consistent, and label the first and last frames.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Prepare stills for an image-to-video workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Design a character sheet
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my original mascot reference to define fixed traits. Write prompts for three views, six expressions, six actions, and one transparent cutout.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Prepare variations of a recurring character.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a background replacement
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a prompt to replace the supplied character image background with a morning studio scene. Preserve the face, pose, jacket, and original lighting direction. Extend the canvas to 16:9 and leave room on the right for captions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Adapt an existing image for a new scene and frame size.

output_examples.input: Write a vertical cover prompt for a tutorial on growing basil indoors.
output: Cover, 9:16: Show one basil plant in a clay pot on a simple kitchen windowsill.
Frame the plant from slightly above and use soft morning light on the leaves.
Leave the top third clear for a title. Do not render text or add other plants.

output_examples.input: Plan five storyboard frames for a video about a paper boat drifting across a puddle.
output: Continuity, 9:16: Keep the blue paper boat, brick curb, and soft overcast light in all five frames.
First frame: Show a hand placing the boat at the near edge.
Frame two: Show the boat tipping as it reaches a ripple.
Frame three: Use a low angle as the boat straightens and drifts forward.
Frame four: Widen the view as the boat reaches the far edge.
Last frame: Hold a close view of the boat resting beside the curb.

output_examples.input: Create a pose and cutout prompt for my original robot mascot.
output: Fixed traits: Keep the square cream head, single amber eye, and teal work jacket.
Pose: Show the robot in a front view with one hand raised and both feet visible.
Cutout: Keep the full silhouette visible with clean edges and no shadow. Use a plain green background if the model cannot produce transparency.

best_practices: State the target platform and aspect ratio before drafting a cover or storyboard.
Record fixed character traits before writing variations, and use an approved reference image when appearance matters.
Review generated frames at phone size for character changes, unwanted text, and missing title space.
anti_patterns: Changing costume, palette, and lighting between frames that should share one visual identity.
Asking the image model to add a title when the title will be set in a video editor.
Assuming that a transparent-background prompt always produces a file with real transparency.

faq.question: Does the skill generate images or videos?
faq.answer: No. It writes prompts and review notes for use with a separate image or video tool.

faq.question: Which image models are the prompts designed for?
faq.answer: The workflow targets Nano Banana and Gemini image generation. Other image models may need changes to prompt wording or settings.

faq.question: Can it keep a character identical across every frame?
faq.answer: No. It repeats fixed traits to reduce variation. Use a reference image when the model supports it and review the results.

faq.question: What if my image model cannot export a transparent background?
faq.answer: Request a plain white or green background instead, then remove it in an image or video editor.

faq.question: Which languages can it use for prompts?
faq.answer: It supports Chinese, English, and bilingual prompts. By default, it provides Chinese guidance with concise English prompt text.

faq.question: What can I provide as a starting point?
faq.answer: Provide a video concept, script, character brief, or production notes. Add the platform and any visual details that must stay fixed.
